messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Elevated 504/502 rate observed from gateway-prod (us-east-1) starting ~now. Pager triggered for SRE oncall. Impact: user requests failing with upstream timeouts. Logs: sampling request_ids in thread.

aj: I'm on it — pulling telemetry. Any customer-facing incidents yet?

maria.g: seeing a spike in gateway 504s and backend model-serving connection resets. Error rate ~7% over the last 5m for route /v1/generate.

kevin: hitting a pattern — a lot of short requests with seq_len 8-32, and the model nodes show high KV cache miss rates, causing frequent cold LRU loads to disk. That seems to be stalling the model workers.

samir: confirming. model-serving nodes (ms-*) show kv_cache_miss/sec jump x15, concurrent fetches to backing store saturating disk IO.

leah: customer-impact: CS reports 4 customer complaints in last 15m, small PLG apps timing out on inference. Adding severity: P1-ish since degradation is global-ish but partial.

aj: mitigation options on the table: 1) enable per-route circuit breaker & raise gateway timeout to 60s temporarily, 2) force route fallback to smaller model variant, 3) throttle bursty API keys, 4) reboot a couple of hot model nodes. Thoughts?

maria.g: start with safe, reversible config tweaks: throttle burst per API key to 50r/s, and enable fallback to model-compact for non-SLA keys. We should also increase gateway upstream timeout to 45s for a short window.

samir: I'll put a short-lived autoscale pause and drain new sessions to hot instances to stop extra cold loads. Patch: change autoscaler min->current to avoid scale-in/out during mitigation.

kevin: I can push a runtime flag to enable aggressive in-memory KV prefetch for small prompts which should reduce disk stalls, but that's a code deploy (hotfix). Prefer keeping deploy for later if config mitigates.

aj: ok action plan: (A) Apply throttling + fallback + gateway timeout (maria) (B) Pause autoscaler (samir) (C) Observe 10m. If error rate not reduced -> (D) deploy kevin's hotfix.

maria.g: applying throttling rule now. CLI:```redwoodctl routes update --route /v1/generate --rate-limit-burst 50 --rate-limit-window 1s```

maria.g: enabling fallback routing to model-compact for requests without enterprise flag:```redwoodctl routing set-fallback --route /v1/generate --when overloaded --model model-compact-v1```

maria.g: bumping gateway upstream timeout to 45s (will revert after mitigation):```kubectl -n gateway set env deployment/gateway GATEWAY_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT=45s```

samir: autoscaler pause:```terraform apply -target=module/autoscaler_pause -var='asg=ms-serving-asg'``` — pausing new scale actions for 15m. Draining new sessions on two worst nodes.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: revert-timeout-config job created to auto-revert in 30m.

kevin: watching logs. kv_cache_miss/sec trend starting to drop after throttling + fallback. Disk IO percentile also dropping. Good sign.

aj: error rate down from 7% -> 1.8% in 6m. Latency still elevated but trending down. Keep observing.

leah: CS update: notified affected customers about degraded service and mitigation in progress. No escalations yet.

samir: we've isolated two model-serving pods with repeated connection resets — taking them out of rotation for healthcheck and will redeploy. Doing rolling restart of ms-03 and ms-07.

kevin: roll restarts started. If restarts clear internal state, we may avoid hotfix deploy.

aj: timeline notes for post-incident: we should add a specific runbook entry for KV-cache thrash events (thresholds, quick-config mitigations, fallback policy), and tune alert thresholds around kv_cache_miss/sec to avoid noise.

maria.g: Confirming rollback plan: once healthy metrics for 10m, we'll revert gateway timeout and remove throttles. I'll also set a 2-hour postmortem check-in.

kevin: if we see repeated recurrence after revert, we'll fast-track the runtime prefetch hotfix. I'll start a PR with tests.

leah: action item for product/CS: prepare customer-facing FAQ blurb in case larger subset sees issues.

aj: summarizing immediate action items: 1) keep throttles & fallback for 20m (maria) 2) autoscaler paused + pod drains (samir) 3) restart two bad pods (samir/kevin) 4) monitor metrics and CS queue (leah) 5) PR for runtime fix (kevin) 6) runbook + alert tuning ticket (aj). Assign owners.

maria.g: metrics look stable for 8m, error rate ~0.9%. I'll start reverting throttles in 10m if stable.

samir: autoscaler unpause scheduled in 20m. Leaving notes in runbook.

kevin: restarted pods healthy, no more connection resets in the sample logs.

aj: great work. We'll close pager when we hit 30m of stability. Follow-up meeting in 1h for action-item assignments and runbook changes.

leah: filing customer notes and posting template to #customer-success.

maria.g: postmortem draft ticket: TICKET-4921. Will include timeline, logs, mitigations, and proposed runbook additions: - new alert: kv_cache_miss/sec > 200 for >3m - auto-fallback policy by route - throttle heuristics per API key - autoscaler pause checklist - rollout of runtime prefetch hotfix.

aj: closing note: kudos to team for quick config mitigations. We'll keep the hotfix PR on standby. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident: degraded gateway 5xx/504 — mitigated and monitoring. Triggering post-incident workflow and assigning runbook ticket to oncall.

maria.g: marking thread for follow-up.

kevin: uploading sampled logs and flamegraphs to the incident doc. Link: https://redwood.internal/incident/2215007890/docs

leah: scheduling the 1h follow-up now: calendar invite sent.

aj: closing thread for now — will update when follow-up meeting finishes.
